body:
## What this ticket includes

This Tiqets listing (`p1111495`) provides reserved-entry admission to the **Uffizi Gallery (Galleria degli Uffizi)** in Florence, allowing visitors to view the Medici family's collection of ancient Roman statuary, copies of lost Greek originals, and Renaissance paintings without waiting in the unreserved general ticket line.

When verified on 28 October 2026, the listing offered three distinct checkout configurations:
- **Uffizi Gallery: Hosted Entry Ticket** — timed admission facilitated by an agency host.
- **Uffizi Gallery: Hosted Entry Ticket + Audio Guide** — adds a downloadable audio guide for self-paced commentary across an estimated 2-hour (`120 min`) visit.
- **Uffizi Gallery & Vasari Corridor: Reserved Entry + Audio Guide App** — adds reserved access to the elevated Vasari Corridor linking the Uffizi toward the Arno.

## Multi-supplier hosted entry format

Unlike direct state museum vouchers that scan immediately at a turnstile, this listing operates through seven registered partner suppliers listed on the page: **City Tours Co Uk Ltd**, **Crown Tours srl**, **Inside Out Italy srl**, **Italy Pass SRLS**, **ACCORD Italy Smart Tours & Experiences**, **Enjoy Rome**, and **Vox City International**. For hosted entry options, you meet the designated supplier representative at the meeting point stated on your post-purchase voucher to receive your physical entry ticket and pass through the reserved-access gate.

## Operating hours and booking rules

- **Opening hours:** The Uffizi Gallery is open **Tuesday through Sunday from 08:15 to 18:30** and is **closed every Monday**.
- **Strict cancellation terms:** Tickets booked under this listing are **non-refundable** and **cannot be rescheduled** once confirmed.
- **Who it suits:** Best for travelers whose preferred timeslot is sold out on the state museum portal or who want a bundled Vasari Corridor or audio-guide ticket in a single checkout.
